newsitem.title: USA: Ameritech wins fifth Chicago-area cable franchise.
newsitem.headline: Ameritech wins fifth Chicago-area cable franchise.

text.p: Ameritech Corp said Wednesday the Arlington Heights Board of Trustees approved a plan to allow residents to choose the regional telephone service provider to deliver cable television service.

The company said the 15-year cable television franchise calls for Ameritech New Media to offer its americast service to the community of 75,500 in early 1998. The americast service will initially contain between 80 and 90 channels of video programming, Ameritech said.
Ameritech New Media is already offering americast in the Chicago suburbs of Glendale Heights, Naperville and Glen Ellyn and has a frachise agreement with the community of Vernon Hills.
Ameritech is a telephone and cable television service provider. Its shares were up 1/8 Wednesday at 59-3/4.
